summary: Phase 1 scaffold complete. Root Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind project; tapit-attest wired as file: dependency; Supabase magic-link auth via @supabase/supabase-js; on first login the wallet prompts for a passphrase, calls Wallet.generate(), encrypts the snapshot via exportEncrypted(), persists ciphertext to both IndexedDB (local fast) and Supabase wallet_blobs (cross-device); on return, the unlock prompt decrypts via Wallet.restore. Home screen renders one IdentityCard. Feature-first folder structure under src/features/<slug>/ with a manifest.ts per slug per CLAUDE.md doctrine. Cheap fast shell — index.html paints inline before React mounts, Vite manualChunks splits react/supabase/attest into separate bundles, login surface ships ~110KB gzipped without IndexedDB or tapit-attest weight; wallet-core lazy-loads post-auth.

why.text: Operator greenlit Phase 1 with explicit constraints: 'use efficient code modules easy to work on and cheap fast to load shell.' Translates to feature-first modularity (small focused files per concern, each in its slug folder), manualChunks code-splitting (login surface tiny, wallet weight deferred), hand-rolled SW (no workbox bloat), inline shell paint (first paint ~50ms). The scaffold composes tapit-attest primitives (Wallet.generate, exportEncrypted, Wallet.restore) without reimplementing crypto — one library, one envelope standard per CLAUDE.md prime directive.

files_changed: 48 files: configs, index.html, public/*, src/**, supabase/migrations/*, plus a one-line touch to src/shared/persona-contract.test.ts to remove an unused @ts-expect-error directive
outcome.tests_passing: root: 16/16 (12 persona-contract parity + 4 new manifest-registry coverage). tapit-attest: 74/74 active (4 skipped, unchanged from prior session)
outcome.notes: All four root gates green — typecheck clean, lint 0/0, tests 16/16, vite build 2.01s producing 133 modules with manual chunks (react 52KB gz, supabase 54KB gz, attest 22KB gz, wallet-provider 2KB gz lazy, home 0.8KB gz lazy). One commit d29fbd0 pushed to claude/compare-library-wallet-OW5FF AND to main (fast-forward direct-push per PFOR-016). NOT VERIFIED: visual rendering or end-to-end auth round-trip in a browser — sandbox has no browser. Operator must run npm run dev locally with real Supabase credentials to confirm the magic-link flow.

uncertainty: Code correctness is verified by the four gates but feature correctness (does the magic-link redirect actually land authenticated? does the encrypted snapshot round-trip cleanly to Supabase under real RLS?) requires a browser session against a real Supabase project, which only the operator can run.
next: Operator provisions a Supabase project, fills .env.local with VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, applies the wallet_blobs migration, runs npm run dev, and walks the magic-link → passphrase → key-gen → home-screen flow. Once verified, Phase 2 (identity attestation + backup posture) is the next session — first-run display-name flow, self-signed identityAttestation, settings screen with cloud-toggle and local-export.
